video:video.video:description: Thirty-five Mexicans deported from the United States arrived in Honduras on Thursday, part of a recent shift in which U.S. authorities are increasingly sending Mexican nationals to Central America before their return home.

video:video.video:title: Two organizers of Hong Kong's Tiananmen vigils convicted in national security case
video:video.video:description: Two former organizers of Hong Kong’s decades-old vigil in remembrance of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown have been convicted in a national security case.

video:video.video:title: Hungary drained its waters for generations. Now drought is exposing the cost
video:video.video:description: Record-low water levels are offering a stark view of Hungary’s worsening water crisis. Years of drought and climate-driven heat are being compounded by a water-management system built to drain precipitation from fields, wetlands and soil.

video:video.video:title: Officers fall trying to make arrest as deck collapses
video:video.video:description: Dramatic body camera footage shows nine members of a U.S. Marshals Service task force falling to the ground as a second-story wooden deck they were standing on suddenly collapses.

video:video.video:title: Provincial leader says Trump is a ‘bad person’ as Canada weighs concessions for trade deal
video:video.video:description: The premier of a Canadian province launched a blistering attack on U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday, calling him a “bad person” and “not to be trusted” and urging Canada to keep fighting rather than rush to make concessions in trade talks with Washington.
